# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen (Volume 1); seventeen (Volume 2)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Stonebridge  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

She possesses lovely skin, stylishly arranged curly brown hair, and a round, cheerful face. She is somewhat plump, describing herself as a dumpling, and has an apple-blossom complexion.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Pragmatic, sensible, and matter-of-fact, she approaches life without overly romanticizing it. She is cheerful and enjoys fun, but lacks a dramatic imagination and prefers not to dwell on depressing topics. Though she tries to remain sensible, she is prone to crying during emotional moments and can be competitive or proud about practical matters.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)_

## Traits

- Pragmatic and sensible  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>
- Cheerful  <sub>[v1 c15 P21](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0021)</sub>

- Prone to weeping when emotional  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- Domestic science and preparing lettuce salad  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- Pass her Regent's entrance exams and become a teacher to earn an independent income  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette attended school in Brierley, preparing for the Regent's Academy entrance exam under Mr. Pidgeon and later Miss Thorne. She participated in various community and school events, including performing music at the Sunday-school picnic and acting in dialogues. During her time at school, she joined Nell Harcourt's Story Club and the Brierley Village Improvement Society, where she served on the hall-painting committee. After passing her Entrance exams, she was offered a teaching position at the Stonebridge school, beginning her career there in the autumn.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)_
